name: Confront Lorthuna
label: Quest
description: Confront Lorthuna: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.
I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.
Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I sent a few of our remaining mages to ensure that Valennia and her forces were able to escape as well. She should be resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence now.

Ansirem had to return to Azeroth, but he and I discussed the next steps for the High Order before he departed. We survived the day, but Zephras is dangerously vulnerable now and we must make plans for what is to come.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
